stages.proper_layer: source evidence acquisition and scene mapping
stages.impact: All claims, quoted language, and selected source screens trace to the video transcript and scene map.
Claims, sources, and authentic visual assets are normalized before slide construction.
The deck distinguishes demonstrated mechanisms from hypotheses and converts them into bounded pilot criteria.
A fourteen-slide arc moves from thesis through proof, interpretation, pilot design, and authorization.
All fourteen slides carry visible claims, interpretation, and decision relevance; notes extend rather than replace slide content.
Seven candidate directions were compared and candidate seven became a visibly distinct Decision Flight Recorder world.
State tracks, decision boards, split-field contrasts, and bounded loops make abstract adoption logic inspectable.
The visual specification deliberately routes structured graphics to editable native PowerPoint geometry and reserves raster imagery for authentic evidence.
The governed branded template, typography, palette roles, and reusable slide archetypes are encoded in reproducible builder source.
Fourteen native speaker notes were added without rebuilding or flattening the presentation.

stages.proper_layer: structural scan, real rendering, and packaging QA
stages.impact: The final notes-bearing deck has zero reported issues, a clean design lint, and a manually inspected real PowerPoint render.

material_differences: Dark operational canvas replaces proof-paper framing.
Signal tracks and numbered states replace generic cards.
Authentic screens behave as instrument readouts rather than decorative screenshots.
Oversized verdicts make the decision explicit on every pivotal slide.
Cyan, lime, violet, and coral carry stable semantic roles across the deck.
